summary: ZKH Group Ltd (NYSE: ZKH) announced in a Form 6-K the resignation of CFO Chiu Chun Lai for personal reasons, effective immediately, with no disagreement over operations. The board appointed Qian Wang as CFO, bringing over 13 years of corporate finance and investment banking experience, including roles at J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley. This is a sudden CFO departure without a transition period, classifying it as a forced/abrupt change. No financial terms or shareholder vote needed. Watch for potential impact on investor relations and strategic direction; no arbitrage angle exists.
